title: 第1377章 暗天矛显威第1376章 焚天圣主出手
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：九龙吞天诀第1377章暗天矛显威（..la）圣君九重的一掌，堪称夺天地造化。
那一掌之下，林炎就好像是笼中鸟，瓮中鳖，没有丝毫活路。
“暗天矛！”
可，就在这危机时刻。
林炎手中的暗天矛，却是释放出璀璨光芒。
“在我冥界地盘上，还敢杀我冥界传人，放肆！”
暗天矛猛地刺出，在众人惊骇的目光之下，竟然直接将焚天圣主的手掌都给击穿了。
“啊！”
金色血液狂涌，焚天圣主发出一声吃痛惊叫，眼瞳满是难以置信。
“怎么回事？焚天圣主居然在一个蝼蚁手中受伤了！”
暗影神殿的副殿主大惊。
圣殿的副殿主和大长老武天罡亦是不禁色变。
难不成林炎隐藏有境界？
否则怎么可能跨越一个大境界还要多，去逆伐圣君九重？！
“不对，不是那小畜生自身之力，是那道黑色长矛！”
武天罡惊声道。
轰轰轰！
暗天矛震动，长矛之上有着一道道古老纹路浮现。
周遭天地之中无穷的冥界之力都涌入暗天矛之中。
除了冥界之力外，虚空中甚至还有着一道道血色的符文被点亮，这些血色符文之玄妙，甚至超出了在场几位风云榜顶级巨头的认知。

“这！
这血色符文，怎么有点沾染超脱的气息？这根长矛，竟然能调动埋藏在此地无尽岁月的超脱之力！”
圣殿副殿主头皮发麻。
他曾觐见过圣族超脱，而此刻暗天矛所调用的血色符文，隐隐间竟然有点当初他觐见圣族巨头的威势了！
虽然，没那么强，但是却也很相近！
“快！
快阻止那根长矛！
不能让它恢复！”
武天罡低喝。
焚天圣主也不是傻子，也是在发现不对劲之后，第一时间就出手，金色的火焰之力汹涌而动，化作两只巨掌，要将暗天矛压制下来。
这根神矛，肯定有问题！
“滚开！”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 1377 of the Nine Dragons Devouring Heaven Art, the Demonic Power of the Dark Sky Spear (..la) The palm of the Holy Lord Jiuzhong can be said to conquer the heaven and earth.
Under that palm, Lin Yan was like a bird in a cage, a turtle in an urn, with no way to survive.
"Dark Sky Spear!"
But, in this moment of crisis.
The Dark Sky Spear in Lin Yan's hand released a bright light.
"You dare to kill my descendants from the underworld on my territory in the underworld, how outrageous!"
The Dark Sky Spear thrust out suddenly, and under the horrified gazes of everyone, it actually penetrated the palm of Holy Lord Burning Sky.
"Ah!"
Golden blood surged wildly, and Holy Lord Fentian let out a scream of pain, his eyes filled with disbelief.
"What's going on? Holy Lord Fentian was injured in the hands of an ant!"
The deputy temple master of the Shadow Temple was shocked.
Wu Tiangang, the deputy temple master and chief elder of the temple, could not help but change his expression.
Is it possible that Lin Yan has a hidden realm?
Otherwise, how could it be possible to cross a larger realm and defeat the ninth level of the Saint King? !
"No, it's not the little beast's own power, it's the black spear!"
Wu Tiangang said in shock.
Boom boom boom!
The Dark Sky Spear shook, and ancient lines appeared on the spear.
The infinite power of the underworld in the surrounding world poured into the Dark Sky Spear.
In addition to the power of the underworld, there were even blood-colored runes lit up in the void. The mystery of these blood-colored runes even exceeded the knowledge of several top giants present.
"This!
Why does this bloody rune have an aura of detachment? This spear can actually mobilize the transcendent power buried here for endless years! "
The deputy head of the temple felt numb.
He had once met the Saint Tribe's Transcendence, but at this moment, the blood-colored runes used by the Dark Sky Spear were faintly as powerful as when he met the Saint Tribe giant!
Although it's not that strong, it's still very close!
"Quick!
Stop that spear!
Can't let it recover! "
Wu Tiangang drank lowly.
Holy Lord Burning Sky was not a fool. After discovering that something was wrong, he immediately took action. The power of golden flames surged and turned into two giant palms to suppress the Dark Sky Spear.
There must be something wrong with this divine spear!
"Get away!"
